decisions: Minutes from the January 22, 2025 board meeting approved without amendment.

One additional analyst to be reassigned to the Polestar Industries account effective February 24, 2025.
Aiyana Park to schedule and lead a formal escalation call with the Polestar Industries project sponsor by February 26, 2025.

Margaret Holvan authorized to execute letter of intent with regional logistics partner, subject to legal counsel review.
Business development pipeline report added as a standing monthly agenda item.
